tools.title: Blue Collar Banker Qualifier
tools.description: A practical lead qualifier for estimating funding readiness based on basic business profile signals.
tools.primaryUseCase: Pre-screen a business funding lead before pushing them into a full application.

tools.title: Funding Match Quiz
tools.description: A quiz-style intake tool intended to route users toward likely funding families.
tools.primaryUseCase: Classify a prospect by use case, revenue, time in business, and funding need.

tools.title: Fundability Score
tools.description: A fundability/readiness scoring widget for structured intake and CRM handoff.
tools.primaryUseCase: Estimate readiness and identify friction points before application review.

tools.title: Startup Planner
tools.description: A planning tool for startup funding readiness, early capital paths, and business-credit preparation.
tools.primaryUseCase: Help newer businesses understand whether they need funding, readiness work, or credit-leverage planning.

tools.title: Cost of Capital Calculator
tools.description: A calculator for comparing the cost and ROI implications of different funding scenarios.
tools.primaryUseCase: Help a business owner understand whether capital cost makes sense relative to the business use case.

tools.title: DSCR Pre-Check
tools.description: A real estate investor pre-check for DSCR-style deal conversations.
tools.primaryUseCase: Estimate whether a rental/investor property profile may be worth reviewing.

tools.title: E-commerce Cashflow Tool
tools.description: A seller-focused cash-flow planning tool for inventory, payout gaps, and platform-driven funding conversations.
tools.primaryUseCase: Help marketplace sellers understand cash-flow pressure before seeking capital.

tools.title: Partner Dashboard
tools.description: A static dashboard-style page for partner tracking concepts and future attribution workflows.
tools.primaryUseCase: Support partner enablement and tracking education.
